checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large tired face
must.why: 640x384 is about 5:3, not exactly 16:9, but the face is large and clearly tired with dark circles.

must.item: Headline of exactly three words, not placeholder
must.why: Three words appear, but two are misspelled: SCOLLING and SLEP.
The intent is clearly stop scrolling and sleep.
White and yellow text with a black outline on a dark background is very readable.

must.item: Face and headline unobstructed, not awkwardly cropped
must.why: Text is clear of the face. The face is slightly cropped at the top but acceptable.

faults.what: Headline misspelled: 'SCOLLING' is missing the R and 'SLEP' is missing an E. The assistant told the user to check spelling but did not fix it.
Image is 640x384, not true 16:9 and not 1280x720.
Hand holding the phone is dark and partly cropped at the bottom.

summary: The thumbnail has a strong tired blue-lit face and a readable layout, but the headline is misspelled ("SCOLLING", "SLEP"), so it can't be posted.
